question: Thrissur Pooram festival is held annually in Kerala at which famous temple?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vadakunnathan Temple**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Thrissur Pooram festival - **

 
 
• It is celebrated in the month of **Medam (April-May)**.
 
• It features a procession of richly caparisoned elephants from various temples to the Vadakunnathan temple.
 
 
 
• **Vadakunnathan temple - **
 
 
• It is a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, situated in the city of Thrissur.
 
• **Murals of Mahabharata **can be seen inside the temple.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sivagiri temple -**

 
 
• This temple was made by **Shree Narayana Guru **in **1904**.
 
• It is located in the Trivandrum district.
 
 
 
• **Tali Temple - **
 
 
• This temple is also dedicated to Lord Shiva.
 
• Present in **Kozhikode**, Kerala.
 
 
 
• **Thiruvalla Temple -** 
 
 
• Also known as **Sree Vallabha** Temple.
 
• It is dedicated to lord Shiva as well.
 
• Famous festivals celebrated in this temple are **Thiru Uthsavam** and **Uthra Sreebali.**
